description: Shell script for testing Git diff behavior with symmetric merge bases, including setup of various merge scenarios and multiple test cases for 'git diff' and related commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with setup commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands after test execution.
